t_mono_ns.description: R-5.2 applies unchanged: monotonic, epoch is boot or session start, never Unix

t_wall_ms.description: R-3.2.1 — present if and only if clock.rtc is true

seq.description: R-3.2.1 — the T0 counter, independent of the T1 counter; gaps stay visible as gaps

event_space.description: R-3.2.1 — pins the recogniser exactly as feature_space pins the transform; any recogniser change changes this

code.description: R-3.2.1 — MUST appear in the descriptor's t0.events[]

confidence.description: R-3.2.1 — the recogniser's own posterior; omitted, not 1.0, when the recogniser has none

t1_seq.description: R-3.2.2 — seq of the last exported T1 frame the recogniser consumed; ABSENT when the recogniser does not run on exported T1 frames

duration_ms.description: R-3.2.2 — span the event covers; 0 for an instantaneous event

quality.description: aggregate contact quality of the window decided on; never the same number as confidence
